news.title: Illinois crypto tax is impossible to enforce as written, crypto industry tells court
news.summary: The legal battle to head off the crypto transaction tax in Illinois has drawn up a hefty roster of industry opposition, and they're saying the tax won't work.

news.title: North Korea's Binance hack faces U.S. crackdown as DOJ targets $1.2 billion in stolen crypto
news.summary: Federal authorities say they've taken infrastructure used in the FaceStealer scheme used to steal as much as $400 million in crypto assets.

news.title: Bitcoin dips below $70,000 as Dollar Index hits 19-month high
news.summary: The crypto market selloff gathered pace early Friday. Bitcoin dropped below $70,000 and ether traded below $2,000, triggering large liquidations in futures market.

news.title: SpaceX-Tesla merger talks put 30,000 bitcoin back in focus
news.summary: A deal could be announced as soon as December, putting $2.1 billion of bitcoin under one roof, a sliver of what the combined group would be worth.

news.title: Bitcoin ETFs are now down over $1.5 billion in net outflows for the year
news.summary: Recent rapid redemptions explain the market swoon. Bitcoin's spot price fell below $70,000 on Friday, the lowest since August.

news.title: Bitcoin firm Nakamoto owes Kraken $165 million, more than its entire market value
news.summary: About 70% of the bitcoin treasury firm’s coins are pledged to the exchange, bought at roughly $118,000 each, and bitcoin now trades under $69,000.

news.title: Ethereum treasury firm BTCS sold ether at a loss to keep $64 million Aave loan healthy
news.summary: The Nasdaq-listed company has 46,676 ETH backing its borrowings, and the loan could become eligible for liquidation if ether slides to around $1,700.

news.summary: Gain insight on Experian, SoFi Technologies and more in the latest Market Talks covering Financial Services.

news.title: Stocks Sink in Broad AI Rout Sparked by China's DeepSeek
news.summary: U.S. stocks were mostly lower, with the Nasdaq leading declines as makers of AI infrastructure suffered steep falls, many in the double digits. Nvidia was down 16%.
